capability_constraints.note: Every mapping rule has an explicit disposition: independently witnessed, structural-only, unsupported by the 0.4.1 authoring surface, not-run pending scanner execution, or blocked on a normative/semantic decision. No rule is silently counted as complete.

normative_holds.question: When lowering an OVAL variable_state/var_ref, is Test.variable sufficient, or must a native identity-State predicate be retained?
outcomes: allow Test.variable substitution when identity is entailed
require an explicit native identity-State field or reject lowering

normative_holds.question: Does a wildcard select request produce a semantic ERROR, or is it a schema-invalid authoring form?

selectors.note: The selector suite exercises every declared alternative; native selector enum/pattern boundary values and collector execution remain separate gates.

enum_boundaries.note: Only schema-backed enum selectors reject the sentinel; unconstrained selector strings are not falsely called enum coverage.

cardinalities.note: Dedicated schema-valid cardinality witnesses cover each token; real collector/cardinality execution remains an RI qualification gate.

exceptional_outcomes.note: Disabled is exercised as profile policy and is not silently inferred as a technical Test outcome; status propagation still requires RI receipts.
